operator_assessment.operator_summary: The plan is suitable for club and ice-booking review, but not for publication as final. Targeted canonical maintenance resolved 11 of 23 unplaced hosting obligations and cut open findings from 280 to 210 with zero hard violations, and the five reserved ROVO/external guest places are legal, verified and visible. What remains is real operational work rather than planner error: 12 unplaced obligations (10 of them Jar's, driven by Jar's conflicted ice), 12 Jar hosting-balance points, one Kongsberg movable-ice confirmation, and a participation shortfall pattern the bounded searches could not improve.

key_tradeoffs.title: Every JU10/JU12 tournament was full, so each guest place cost one RVV seat
key_tradeoffs.summary: No zero-displacement reservation existed. The five displacements were chosen from the repository's declared legal displacement facts, targeting teams sitting exactly on target so the damage is one unit each: Ringerike 1 and Skien (JU10), Frisk Asker Orange and Frisk Asker Svart (JU12). Only Frisk Asker Svart (JU10) reaches -2 for the season; no already-deficient Jar JU10 team was touched.

key_tradeoffs.title: Hosting rehosts to Jar were declined
key_tradeoffs.summary: All 22 available hosting-balance repairs relocate an existing tournament into Jar Isforum, and every one of them converts a lower-priority fair-share point into a new unresolved manual placement needing ice confirmation at Jar's conflicted arena. One was applied, measured and reverted with a canonical move. Jar's deficit is left visible instead.

key_tradeoffs.title: Two coupled cross-age exchanges do not survive export normalization
key_tradeoffs.summary: Materializing the U10 2026-11-21 and U11 2026-11-21 obligations produced real tournaments rvv-0043-era placements rvv-0033 and rvv-0057 that carry fixed external calendar conflicts, so canonical export normalization returns them to unresolved obligations. Canonical state holds 180 tournaments; the export projects 178.

remaining_actions.title: Confirm or replace Kongsberg's movable ice
remaining_actions.summary: rvv-0053 on 2026-11-15 15:00-16:40 sits on host-controlled open ice and needs explicit confirmation from Kongsberg before that slot is final.

remaining_actions.title: Place 12 remaining hosting obligations manually
remaining_actions.summary: 10 Jar, 1 Skien-area and 1 other obligation have no legal automatic slot under the current bounded search. Three U10 and two U12 dates fall inside the canonical Christmas/Easter exclusion window and need a different date from the responsible host; the rest are blocked by fixed external arena bookings.

remaining_actions.title: Decide how to handle Jar's hosting deficit
remaining_actions.summary: Jar owes 12 fair-share hosting points across U9-U12 that its own calendar cannot currently absorb. Either free Jar ice, accept the deficit explicitly, or accept the extra manual ice confirmations that rehosting into Jar Isforum would create.

remaining_actions.title: Review the participation shortfall pattern with the clubs
remaining_actions.summary: 110 shortfalls and 226 target deviations remain, concentrated in Frisk Asker, Jar and Ringerike. They are structurally tied to the 12 missing tournaments; placing those obligations is the main lever.

remaining_actions.title: Offer the five guest places to ROVO/external teams
remaining_actions.summary: Five open reservations await a booking; fill them with 'season guest-fill' or return the seat to an RVV team with 'season guest-release'.

limitations: Calendar sources were not rescraped for this canonical export, so live ice availability was checked only against the promoted source snapshot.

Twelve unplaced obligations and the remaining participation deviations are bounded-search exhausted under the current search capability, which is not a proof of infeasibility; a widened neighbourhood may still find placements.
No claim of global optimality is made: the improvements are verified non-dominated local repairs, not an exhaustive search of the season.
The distribution of the five guest places across dates, halves and hosts is a contextual judgement made from deterministic candidate facts, not a repository-proven optimum.

checklist_findings.question: Antall cuper pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: 110 participation shortfalls and 226 target deviations remain; none are classified avoidable (173 bounded_search_exhausted, 13 proven_infeasible). The five guest reservations each removed one RVV seat, adding 9 deviation findings: Ringerike 1 (JU10) and Skien (JU10) fall from on-target to -1 season, Frisk Asker Orange (JU12) and Frisk Asker Svart (JU12) to -1 season, Frisk Asker Svart (JU10) from -1 to -2 season.

checklist_findings.question: Antall hjemmeturneringer pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: No unresolved hosting obligations, but 12 hosting-balance imbalance points remain, all Jar (U10 -2, U11 -2, U12 -3, U9 -1). 12 unplaced tournament placements remain, 10 of them Jar's, caused by fixed external calendar conflicts, the canonical holiday exclusion window and one no-participant-host-slot case. Hosting responsibility was preserved in every repair; no obligation was transferred to a club that does not owe it.

checklist_findings.question: Lengde på turneringer?
checklist_findings.finding: All 178 exported tournaments have a duration (100-155 min) equal to their required duration; 0 blocking byes. Six JU8 tournaments are input-constrained by a 5-team registered pool, which is an input fact, not a planner defect. The five guest tournaments are shape-valid: 5 RVV + 1 guest place = 6 (JU10) and 3 RVV + 1 guest place = 4 (JU12), exactly the configured capacity, and none is flagged underfilled.

checklist_findings.question: Er det faktisk ledig tid på is?
checklist_findings.finding: One movable-ice allocation still needs host confirmation: rvv-0053, Kongsberg, 2026-11-15 15:00-16:40 over a host-controlled 'Apen Ishall' slot. No unresolved external conflicts and no calendar interpretations were used in the exported plan. Source evidence was not rescraped for this canonical export, so live ice availability beyond the promoted snapshot could not be independently reconfirmed.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar vertsklubben i samme turnering?
checklist_findings.finding: 0 tournaments where the host club is absent from the participants. Every host club, including the five guest-slot tournaments, still fields a real participating RVV team; combined clubs such as Kongsberg/Tonsberg satisfy Kongsberg's host representation through the canonical constituent-club rule.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar hvert lag maksimalt én gang per dag?
checklist_findings.finding: 0 duplicate team/day entries across 1013 team-day entries in the canonical plan and 0 in the exported projection.

checklist_findings.question: Er det normalt maks 2 lag fra samme klubb, med 3 kun som synlig unntak?
checklist_findings.finding: Club-per-tournament distribution is 63 with one team, 105 with two and 10 with three; 0 tournaments exceed the hard maximum of 3. The ten three-team cases are visible exceptions, nine of them Jar.

checklist_findings.question: Er eksportformatene konsistente?
checklist_findings.finding: All five export-consistency checks match the exported plan: csv_games 2320 rows, csv_overview 178, csv_team_counts 142, iCal 178 events, Excel 178 overview rows. Guest places do not appear in team counts, so csv_team_counts is unchanged by the five reservations.

checklist_findings.question: Ser harnesset andre materielle problemer eller manglende regler vi ikke allerede har tenkt på?
checklist_findings.finding: One repository defect was found and fixed during this review: the audit-evidence assembler read the plan from the Stage 3 planning checkpoint, so after a canonical 'season export' it described an older run's plan (175 tournaments, 0 guest reservations) and reported four false export-format mismatches. It now reads the exported projection that the export fingerprint is bound to; a regression test covers it. No other material problem was found. Zero hard violations, zero waived violations, zero stale or orphaned approvals, and no scheduled tournament falls on a canonical holiday-excluded date.

potential_missing_rule.description: Audit evidence assembly read the Stage 3 planning checkpoint rather than the exported projection, so a canonical season export was audited against an older run's plan (missing later tournaments and all guest reservations) and reported four false export-format mismatches. Fixed during this review at the evidence/report layer with a regression test.
